thread:
maria: Quick heads-up — during the q4b-int4 bringup we observed deid token fragmentation on long prompts. Golden recall drops ~6-8% for >1024 tokens.
ash: ugh. do we have a minimal repro slice?
maria: yes, narrowed to a few anchors — pushing a sampled slice to GCS: gs://redwood-sandbox/curation/deid_spill/seed_slice_2026-03-18.tgz
lee: can you paste an example snippet? easier to show labelers.
maria: here — one case where the tokenizer inserts a soft-break inside an email-like token and deid rules miss it:
```
input: "Contact: test.user+promo@mail.example.co.uk for details"
tokenized: ["Contact", ":", "test.user+promo@", "mail.example.co", ".", "uk", ...]
rule: deid_regex only matches full hostnames -> misses because of split
```
sam: thanks — so it's a tokenization boundary problem, not model hallucination. good.
devon: might be exacerbated by int4 quant kernel using different chunking for longctx. we saw slight tokenization offsets in the quantized tokenizer shim earlier.
ash: action list?
maria: propose: 1) expand golden to include 2k longprompt deid anchors 2) add normalization pass to recombine email-ish tokens before deid regex 3) update labeler instructions + edge-case examples 4) run quick canary eval vs q4b-int4 and float baseline
lee: I can own labeler doc updates and the new edge-case gallery. will add explicit examples and a quick checklist. ETA EOD tomorrow. @ash can you give me the current labeling rubric link?
ash: https://docs.internal/curation/labeler-rubric (private) — I'll add a short section on token-boundary cases.
sam: I'll wire the canary eval harness to include the new slice. small script to sample long prompts (canary size 2k):
```bash
python tools/sample_holdout.py \
  --src gs://redwood-sandbox/curation/all_prompts.parquet \
  --min_tokens 1024 \
  --seed 42 \
  --out ./holdouts/deid_long_2k.jsonl
```
ash: also add a fingerprint check for tokenization before/after quant kernel. i.e., run tokenizer on float model and qint variant and compare token sequences. small script: 
```py
for txt in sample:
  t_float = tok.encode(txt)
  t_qint = tok_qint.encode(txt)
  if t_float != t_qint:
    log_mismatch(txt)
```
devon: ops note — canary infra has limited cache; if we run many tokenizers in parallel might bump VM CPU. tag me if you want bigger runners.
ops-bot: canary-deploy: q4b-int4 canary started (canary-id: c-2026-03-19-07). status: queued.
maria: timeline: need labeler updates + golden augmentation by Friday so we can run the regression sweep next week.
lee: will draft the labeler section + gallery and ping the QA cohort once done.
ash: I'll add the normalization patch — small pre-tokenizer glue that recombines common email/handle segments. will put a draft PR by EOD.
sam: after PR and new golden, I'll run baseline vs q4b-int4, float32, and q8f - will post a small matrix with recall/precision per deid category.
devon: if the kernel change looks like the root cause we should test alternate kernel selection in runtime (fallback to kernel-v2 for longctx). I'll schedule a quick perf run.
maria: thanks all. tagging follow-ups: @lee (labeler doc + gallery), @ash (rubric + fingerprint script), @nobody (ops if we need more capacity) — I'll track in the ticket: https://tickets.internal/ML-3479
lee: noted :+1:
maria: if anyone sees identical anchored failures outside deid (PII vs urls) call it out — we want the golden to cover url fragments, emails, phones.
ash: I'll add url-phone examples to the normalization rules too.
sam: will post canary results + simple CSV of mismatches once runs complete.
ops-bot: canary-deploy: c-2026-03-19-07 status: running
devon: ping me if canary hits >70% CPU or IO spikes.
maria: great work team. I'll compile a short brief for product next Monday. :eyes:
